newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE TUESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE TUESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting fairly good inquiry from buyers.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00, pen North Plains 65.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 63.50. Pen Select and Choice 2-4 1200 lbs including
Wk to date - 44,800 Last Week - 44,900 Year Ago - 28,500
Sales reported on 2,500 slaughter steers and 1,800
heifers; 44,800 head confirmed for the week to date which
includes 31,700 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
